create_entry.default: The Model Context Protocol server is active. To change which tools its main URL exposes, select **Configure** on the integration.

user.description: The Model Context Protocol server exposes all tools. See the [integration documentation]({more_info_url}) for setup instructions.

snapshot_error.message: An error occurred while reading the Assist context snapshot

error.llm_api_required: Select at least one set of tools or expose all AI tools.

data_description.all_llm_apis: Also exposes sets of tools that integrations add later.
data_description.llm_hass_api: **Device control** only accesses the entities you expose to voice assistants. **Home Assistant** accesses everything and requires an administrator account.
data_description.read_only: Only expose tools that are marked as not changing anything.
data_description.require_admin: Only allow administrator accounts to use the main URL. Some tools always require an administrator account.

init.description: These settings apply to the main URL (`/api/mcp`). Each set of tools also has its own URL, which ignores these settings. See the [integration documentation]({more_info_url}) for setup instructions.
